_doc: The motifs: one note list each, named for who or where it belongs to; a track's layer plays them in its own rhythm on its own instrument (the composer's reference/motifs.md). No rhythm here on purpose.

dani: the game's one tune, Dani's. The title plays it at a note per two beats on the triangle; the boss's lead plays its first seven notes at 128 BPM on a square pair; the Stacks' blips draw from its notes.
